# Neuvents

> Neuvents is a Sofia, Bulgaria based organization specializing in community tech events and conferences across South-Eastern Europe.

## Overview
Neuvents was founded in 2016 and organizes tech conferences, meetups, and community gatherings including Euruko 2016, Partial Conf, Balkan Ruby, and Ruby Banitsa.

## Key Events & Pages
- [Homepage](https://neuvents.com/): Overview of Neuvents, our mission, and community tech events.
- [Balkan Ruby](https://neuvents.com/balkan-ruby): The premier Ruby conference in the Balkan region.
- [Partial Conf](https://neuvents.com/partial-conf): Conference on modern functional programming languages and web technologies.
- [Ruby Banitsa](https://neuvents.com/ruby-banitsa): Local Ruby meetup in Sofia, Bulgaria.
- [Euruko 2016](https://neuvents.com/euruko-2016): European Ruby Conference held in Sofia in 2016.
- [Contacts](https://neuvents.com/contacts): Get in touch with Neuvents event organizers.
- [Legal Information](https://neuvents.com/legal-information): Company information, registration details, and team.
- [Privacy Policy](https://neuvents.com/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling guidelines.
- [Return Policy](https://neuvents.com/returns): Ticket returns and refund policies.
